items.source:
fn safe_relative(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let components: Vec<_> = path.components().collect();
    !components.is_empty()
        && components
            .iter()
            .all(|part| matches!(part, Component::Normal(_)))
        && matches!(
            components[0].as_os_str().to_str(),
            Some(
                "providers.lenv"
                    | "tokens.json"
                    | "tokens.lino"
                    | "requests"
                    | "projects"
                    | "sessions"
            )
        )
        && !components.iter().any(|part| {
            matches!(
                part.as_os_str().to_str(),
                Some(
                    "auth.json"
                        | ".credentials.json"
                        | "credentials.json"
                        | "oauth.json"
                        | "oauth_creds.json"
                        | "refresh-recovery"
                )
            )
        })
}
